systems.platform: birth registration on tablets, integrated with national identity number enrolment
systems.owner: National Population Commission, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: Gombe State as a pilot: trainers from 114 health facilities and 114 wards trained to register births on tablets; ward focal persons hold the devices

note: A UNICEF and National Population Commission campaign in Gombe State (reported 11 Sept 2025) trained people from 114 health facilities and 114 wards to register births on tablets, with the local governments' association pledging the chairmen's support and upkeep. Devices go to ward focal persons and health workers under the Commission's registration; no local government office is said to be connected, and no connection is stated at all, so no fact.
